audit.why: Ability names all real (Razor Shuriken, Living Shadow, Shadow Slash, Death Mark; suspectName on wants.foe[1] is a capitalization false positive). Key interactions stated: mark telegraph, Zhonya's answer, W-down trade window. Real numbers added to cooldowns field.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. It governs your forward steps. - E Abscond (shield-dash) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark (R): 120s at rank 1 — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. - Living Shadow (W) is 20s early: with it down he has no combo and no escape — that is your trade window. - Hold your R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Living Shadow sits at 20s early — the moment he W's out of a trade he has no escape for the next twenty seconds. Chase then.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: E-shield as his combo opens, not after it lands — the absorbed opener is the whole reason you out-sustain him.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Zed wins by shadow-comboing your walk-ups in the 3-5 window and one-shotting you with Death Mark after Eclipse.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Chain Lash out-ranges his single-target poke before the combo exists — zone him off the wave.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: Still yours at 2 — Q harass forces him to burn energy blocking instead of trading back.

edits.before: Full kit: E2-chain into Q-W with passive whirls is the lane's best level-3 all-in nobody respects yet.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: full kit and energy-free harass out-trade you before your double-Q comes online.

edits.before: Chain-trade on cooldown: shield in, stun, whirl the passive autos, heal out. The brawl is the plan.
edits.after: W-in, full combo, W-out — Living Shadow lets him leave before Chain Lash lands. Respect 4-5.

edits.before: Hijack online — your R is whatever his best button is. The lane's power budget just became a shared account.
edits.after: Hold your all-in for his Death Mark commit — Abscond the mark, Abduct him back, Kingslayer executes.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: Eclipse or Youmuu's restores his W-in burst — this is his best solo-kill window again.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: Two items on, your bruiser body, Zhonya's and a Hijacked teamfight ult beat his isolated one-shot.
